user.title: Add Go Gauge HA workspace
user.description: One workspace per integration instance: pick a friendly name and paste that workspace's Go API token. More workspaces = just add the integration again. Tokens are validated live on save; if the network is down you can skip validation.

data.token: Go API token for this workspace

error.cannot_connect: opencode.ai is unreachable right now — skip validation or try again later.
error.invalid_token: Invalid token (HTTP 401) — please check or enable 'Skip validation'.
error.missing_fields: Please provide both name and token.

abort.reauth_failed: The existing Go Gauge entry could not be found.
abort.reauth_successful: Go Gauge HA was re-authenticated successfully.

account_entity_collision.title: Go Gauge: duplicate account entity
account_entity_collision.description: There are multiple registry entries for the account entity "{kind}". {winner} is kept; the duplicates ({losers}) have been disabled. Please delete the disabled entries after checking them.

account_device_merged.title: Go Gauge: duplicate account device removed
account_device_merged.description: Empty duplicate devices were removed: {device}. All account entities now belong to the "Go Gauge Konto" device.

account_device_not_empty.title: Go Gauge: duplicate device could not be removed
account_device_not_empty.description: The device {device} is not empty yet (remaining entities or child devices) and has been left in place. Please check the remaining entries and remove the device manually afterwards.

adoption_unsupported.title: Go Gauge: account device transfer not supported
adoption_unsupported.description: This Home Assistant version cannot move a device to another config entry ({error}). The integration keeps running; please update Home Assistant to 2026.8.0 or newer.

adoption_failed.title: Go Gauge: account entity adoption incomplete
adoption_failed.description: The account entity adoption reported {count} error(s). The integration keeps running and retries the adoption on the next start; see the log for details.
